[2026-08-21T02:17:50.903Z] [player] Ask why they serve
[2026-08-21T02:17:50.903Z] [world] Vael of the Listening Stone gives you a look that measures the question for irony and finds none. "Because somebody stands at this desk, and the last one who stood here was worse. That is the honest shape of it. You do not serve because the cause is clean — no cause is clean. You serve because you have seen the desk empty, and empty is worse."
[2026-08-21T02:17:50.904Z] [world] Vael of the Listening Stone talks to you while doing something else, which is its own kind of trust.
[2026-08-21T02:17:51.521Z] [player] Ask what the post has cost them
[2026-08-21T02:17:51.522Z] [world] "Friends, in the ordinary way — people hear the title before they hear me now." Vael of the Listening Stone straightens something on the desk. "But the real price is smaller and dearer: I have not said a careless sentence in nine years. Every word weighed, every joke checked for edges. You are hearing the loosest I get, and you will notice I am still watching the door."
[2026-08-21T02:17:51.523Z] [world] Vael of the Listening Stone says it as though it has already been written down somewhere and signed.
